# Categorical variable transformation
```{python include=FALSE}
import pandas as pd
import biogemedld dddd
import biogeme.version as ver

# Load Data
file_path = "data/us_data_reduced_hh_0to9_1_dropna.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)
```

```{python}
print(data.columns.tolist())
```

```{python}
# Count NaN values for each variable in the list

print(nan_counts.sort_values(ascending=False))
```

# Formatting variable
```{python echo=FALSE}
# List of variables
variables = ['JourneyWithChildren', 'PRIMMODE', 'TotalTravelTimeMinutes', 'TotalActivityTimeMinutes', 'TourTimeMinutes', 'PRIMPURP', 'IncHouseh', 'inc_quant', 'HHSIZE', 'NUMADLT', 'NumChld', 'YOUNGCHILD', 'num_5_9', 'numu10inhh', 'num1017inhh', 'OlderSibinHH', 'SingleAinHH', 'acc_0_4', 'acc_5_9', 'PartyNumu10', 'PartyNum1017', 'PartyNum017', 'TourCoupleStatus', 'IsWomen', 'IsWorker', 'TourComplexity', 'R_AGE_IMP']
```

# Formating for parameters
```{python, include=FALSE}
# One-hot encode JourneyWithChildren (0/1 format)
data = pd.get_dummies(data, columns=["JourneyWithChildren"], prefix="JWC")
rename_map = {f"JWC_{i}": f"JWC_{i-1}" for i in [1, 2, 3]}
data = data.rename(columns=rename_map)

# Check transformed dataset
print(data.head())

print(data.columns.tolist())
```

# Convert categorical variables
```{python include=FALSE}
# Convert categorical variables to integer codes
categorical_columns = ['PRIMMODE', 'PRIMPURP', 'inc_quant', 'TourCoupleStatus']

data = pd.get_dummies(data, columns=categorical_columns, prefix_sep='_', drop_first=False)


# Convert boolean columns to integers (if applicable)
bool_columns = ["JWC_0", "JWC_1", "JWC_2"]
data[bool_columns] = data[bool_columns].astype(int)

# Drop rows with missing values (or impute them if needed)
data = data.dropna() 
```

```{python}
# Aggregate trip → tour
tour_child_counts = (
  data.groupby("TOURID", as_index=False)["PartyNum1017"]
      .sum()
      .rename(columns={"PartyNum1017": "TotalPartyNum1017"})
)

# Older sibling flag per tour
tour_child_counts["Oldersibling"] = (tour_child_counts["TotalPartyNum1017"] > 0).astype("Int64")

# Merge back to dT (optional, if you want it on each trip row)
data = data.merge(tour_child_counts[["TOURID", "Oldersibling"]], on="TOURID", how="left")

print(data["Oldersibling"].value_counts(dropna=False))
```


```{python}
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Recreate JourneyWithChildren variable from dummy columns
data["JourneyWithChildren"] = data[["JWC_0", "JWC_1", "JWC_2"]].idxmax(axis=1).str[-1].astype(int)

# Then perform the chi-square test
contingency_table = pd.crosstab(data['JourneyWithChildren'], data['Oldersibling'])
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(contingency_table)

print(contingency_table)
print(f"\nChi2 = {chi2:.3f}, df = {dof}, p = {p:.4f}")

print("\nChi-square Statistic:", chi2)
print("Degrees of Freedom:", dof)
print("P-value:", p) 

print("\nExpected Frequencies:")
print(pd.DataFrame(expected, index=contingency_table.index, columns=contingency_table.columns))
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create contingency table
contingency_table = pd.crosstab(data['JourneyWithChildren'], data['Oldersibling'], normalize='index') * 100

# Plot
contingency_table.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, color=['#4c72b0', '#dd8452'])
plt.title('Presence of Older Children (10–17) by JourneyWithChildren Category')
plt.xlabel('JourneyWithChildren')
plt.ylabel('Percentage of Tours')
plt.legend(title='ChildPresence_1017', labels=['No (0)', 'Yes (1)'])
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Create contingency table
contingency = pd.crosstab(data['JourneyWithChildren'], data['Oldersibling'])

# Plot as heatmap
sns.heatmap(contingency, annot=True, fmt="d", cmap="Blues")
plt.title("Joint Distribution: JourneyWithChildren × ChildPresence_1017")
plt.xlabel("ChildPresence_1017 (Older Children 10–17 Present)")
plt.ylabel("JourneyWithChildren (Younger Children 0–9 in Tour)")
plt.show()
```



# Import database
```{python include=FALSE}
import biogeme.database as db
import biogeme.biogeme as bio
from biogeme import models
from biogeme.expressions import Beta
from biogeme . expressions import Variable

# Load data into Biogeme database
#data = data.astype({col: 'int' for col in data.select_dtypes('bool').columns})
#database = db.Database("US_interaction", data)

# Step 1: Convert nullable Int64 -> standard int64, and bool -> int
data = data.astype({col: 'int' for col in data.select_dtypes('bool').columns})

# Step 2: Convert any remaining pandas nullable integer types (Int64, Int32, etc.)
for col in data.columns:
    if hasattr(data[col], 'dtype') and isinstance(data[col].dtype, pd.api.types.pandas_dtype('Int64').__class__):
        data[col] = data[col].astype('float64')  # via float to handle any residual NA

# Step 3: Simpler catch-all — convert everything to standard numpy types
data = data.convert_dtypes(convert_integer=False)  # stop pandas from using Int64
data = data.astype({
    col: 'int64' for col in data.select_dtypes(include=['int', 'Int64']).columns
})

# Step 4: Drop any remaining NaNs to be safe
data = data.dropna()
```

# log transforming
```{python echo=FALSE}
#from biogeme.expressions import Variable, log
#import numpy as np

#Define the symbolic log-transformed variable
#database = db.Database("US_interaction", data)
#TourTimeMinutes = Variable('TourTimeMinutes')
#database.DefineVariable('TTM_scaled', log(TourTimeMinutes))
#TTM_scaled = Variable('TTM_scaled')

# Log transform TravelTimeMinutes using log1p to handle 0s
#log_ttm = np.log1p(data["TourTimeMinutes"])

from biogeme.expressions import Variable, log
import numpy as np

# Convert ALL columns to standard numpy-compatible types at once
# This handles Int64, Float64, boolean, and any other pandas extension types
data = data.astype({
    col: 'float64' if data[col].dtype.kind == 'f' or str(data[col].dtype) == 'Float64'
    else 'int64' if str(data[col].dtype) in ['Int64', 'Int32', 'Int16', 'Int8']
    else data[col].dtype
    for col in data.columns
    if data[col].dtype.name not in ['object', 'category']
})

# Simpler catch-all that covers everything in one line
data = data.apply(lambda col: pd.to_numeric(col, errors='ignore')).astype(
    {col: 'float64' for col in data.select_dtypes(include='number').columns}
)

data = data.dropna()

# Now create the database
database = db.Database("US_interaction", data)
TourTimeMinutes = Variable('TourTimeMinutes')
database.DefineVariable('TTM_scaled', log(TourTimeMinutes))
TTM_scaled = Variable('TTM_scaled')
log_ttm = np.log1p(data["TourTimeMinutes"])
```

```{python include=FALSE}
# Define utility functions (JWC_2 is the reference alternative, so its utility is 0)
V_0 = (
ASC_JWC_0 +
B_time_0 * TTM_scaled +
B_PRIMMODE_Walk_0 * PRIMMODE_Walk +
B_PRIMMODE_Bicycle_0 * PRIMMODE_Bicycle +
B_PRIMMODE_Transit_0 * PRIMMODE_Transit +

B_PRIMPURP_Work_0 * PRIMPURP_Work +
B_PRIMPURP_ShoppingErrands_0 * PRIMPURP_ShoppingErrands +
B_PRIMPURP_LeisureSocial_0 * PRIMPURP_LeisureSocial +

B_YOUNGCHILD_0 * YOUNGCHILD +
B_num1017inhh_0 * num1017inhh +

B_TourComplexity_0 * TourComplexity + 
B_inc_quant_Q1_0 * inc_quant_Q1 +
B_inc_quant_Q2_0 * inc_quant_Q2 +
B_inc_quant_Q3_0 * inc_quant_Q3 +

B_IsWomen_0 * IsWomen +
B_IsWorker_0 * IsWorker +
B_WorkerW_Female_0 * IsWorker * IsWomen +
B_CoupleStatus_Single_0 * TourCoupleStatus_Single +
B_SingleW_Female_0 * TourCoupleStatus_Single * IsWomen
)


V_1 = (
ASC_JWC_1 +
B_time_1 * TTM_scaled +
B_PRIMMODE_Walk_1 * PRIMMODE_Walk +
B_PRIMMODE_Bicycle_1 * PRIMMODE_Bicycle +
B_PRIMMODE_Transit_1 * PRIMMODE_Transit +

B_PRIMPURP_Work_1 * PRIMPURP_Work +
B_PRIMPURP_ShoppingErrands_1 * PRIMPURP_ShoppingErrands +
B_PRIMPURP_LeisureSocial_1 * PRIMPURP_LeisureSocial +

B_YOUNGCHILD_1 * YOUNGCHILD +
B_num1017inhh_1 * num1017inhh +

B_TourComplexity_1 * TourComplexity + 
B_inc_quant_Q1_1 * inc_quant_Q1 +
B_inc_quant_Q2_1 * inc_quant_Q2 +
B_inc_quant_Q3_1 * inc_quant_Q3 +

B_IsWomen_1 * IsWomen +
B_IsWorker_1 * IsWorker +
B_WorkerW_Female_1 * IsWorker * IsWomen +
B_CoupleStatus_Single_1 * TourCoupleStatus_Single +
B_SingleW_Female_1 * TourCoupleStatus_Single * IsWomen
)


V_2 = (
ASC_JWC_2 +
B_time_2 * TTM_scaled +
B_PRIMMODE_Walk_2 * PRIMMODE_Walk +
B_PRIMMODE_Bicycle_2 * PRIMMODE_Bicycle +
B_PRIMMODE_Transit_2 * PRIMMODE_Transit +

B_PRIMPURP_Work_2 * PRIMPURP_Work +
B_PRIMPURP_ShoppingErrands_2 * PRIMPURP_ShoppingErrands +
B_PRIMPURP_LeisureSocial_2 * PRIMPURP_LeisureSocial +

B_YOUNGCHILD_2 * YOUNGCHILD +
B_num1017inhh_2 * num1017inhh +

B_TourComplexity_2 * TourComplexity + 
B_inc_quant_Q1_2 * inc_quant_Q1 +
B_inc_quant_Q2_2 * inc_quant_Q2 +
B_inc_quant_Q3_2 * inc_quant_Q3 +

B_IsWomen_2 * IsWomen +
B_IsWorker_2 * IsWorker +
B_WorkerW_Female_2 * IsWorker * IsWomen +
B_CoupleStatus_Single_2 * TourCoupleStatus_Single +
B_SingleW_Female_2 * TourCoupleStatus_Single * IsWomen
)


# Associate utilities with alternatives
V = {0: V_0, 1: V_1, 2: V_2}
av = {0: Avail_JWC_0, 1: Avail_JWC_1, 2: Avail_JWC_2}
```


```{python include=FALSE}
# 1. Build Choice from dummies
data["Choice"] = data[["JWC_0", "JWC_1", "JWC_2"]].idxmax(axis=1).str[-1].astype(int)

# 2. Convert booleans to integers
bool_columns = data.select_dtypes(include="bool").columns
data[bool_columns] = data[bool_columns].astype(int)

# 3. Recreate database
database = db.Database("US_interaction", data)

# 4. Define Choice as a Biogeme Variable
Choice = Variable("Choice")
```

```{python, echo=TRUE}
# Define the logit model
logprob = models.loglogit(V, av, Choice)

# Create the Biogeme object
the_biogeme = bio.BIOGEME(database, logprob)
the_biogeme.modelName = "Interaction_US"
the_biogeme.calculateNullLoglikelihood (av)

# Estimate the model
results = the_biogeme.estimate()
```

```{python, echo=TRUE}
print (f"HTML file: {results.data.htmlFileName}")
print (f"Pickle file: {results.data.pickleFileName}")
```

```{python, echo=TRUE}
# Print results
pandasResrults = results.getEstimatedParameters()
pandasResrults
```



# ===== SIMULATE P(JWC_2) over a grid of TTM values =====
```{python}
import biogeme.database as db
import biogeme.biogeme as bio
from biogeme import models
from biogeme.expressions import Variable, log

# Make a copy for simulation (optionally edit values here for scenarios)
sim_data = data.copy()

# Build simulation database
sim_database = db.Database("US_interaction_sim", sim_data)

# Define the derived variable on the simulation database
TourTimeMinutes_sim = Variable("TourTimeMinutes")
#sim_database.DefineVariable("TTM_scaled", log(TourTimeMinutes_sim))
TTM_scaled_sim = Variable("TTM_scaled")
```

```{python}
PRIMMODE_Walk_sim = Variable("PRIMMODE_Walk")
PRIMMODE_Bicycle_sim = Variable("PRIMMODE_Bicycle")
PRIMMODE_Transit_sim = Variable("PRIMMODE_Transit")

PRIMPURP_Work_sim = Variable("PRIMPURP_Work")

YOUNGCHILD_sim = Variable("YOUNGCHILD")

inc_quant_Q1_sim = Variable("inc_quant_Q1")
inc_quant_Q2_sim = Variable("inc_quant_Q2")
inc_quant_Q3_sim = Variable("inc_quant_Q3")

IsWomen_sim = Variable("IsWomen")
IsWorker_sim = Variable("IsWorker")

TourCoupleStatus_Single_sim = Variable("TourCoupleStatus_Single")

Avail_JWC_0_sim = Variable("Avail_JWC_0")
Avail_JWC_1_sim = Variable("Avail_JWC_1")
Avail_JWC_2_sim = Variable("Avail_JWC_2")
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

# --- Colors matching the reference image ---
COLOR_0 = '#5b9bd5'   # muted blue  — All children (JWC_0)
COLOR_1 = '#f4a442'   # orange      — Some children (JWC_1)
COLOR_2 = '#5aae61'   # green       — No children (JWC_2)

# --- Rolling average (smoothing window) ---
WINDOW = 15  # adjust to taste; larger = smoother

def rolling(series, w):
    return series.rolling(window=w, center=True, min_periods=1).mean()

plot_df_s = plot_df.sort_values("TourTimeMinutes").copy()
x = plot_df_s["TourTimeMinutes"]

p0 = rolling(plot_df_s["Prob0_roll"], WINDOW)
p1 = rolling(plot_df_s["Prob1_roll"], WINDOW)
p2 = rolling(plot_df_s["Prob2_roll"], WINDOW)

cum0 = p0
cum1 = p0 + p1
cum2 = p0 + p1 + p2  # ≈ 1.0

# --- Plot ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))

ax.fill_between(x, 0,    cum0, color=COLOR_0, alpha=0.85)
ax.fill_between(x, cum0, cum1, color=COLOR_1, alpha=0.85)
ax.fill_between(x, cum1, cum2, color=COLOR_2, alpha=0.85)

# Padding: extend axes beyond data range
ax.set_xlim(x.iloc[0], 700)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.0)
ax.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['bottom'].set_visible(True)
ax.spines['left'].set_color('black')
ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('black')

# Very subtle grid
ax.grid(True, color='lightgray', linewidth=0.3, alpha=0.3, zorder=3)

ax.set_xlabel("Tour Duration (minutes)", fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel("Predicted Probability", fontsize=11)
ax.set_title(
    "Predicted Probabilities by Tour Duration",
    fontsize=12
)

ax.set_facecolor('white')
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

legend_patches = [
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLOR_0, label='All children'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLOR_1, label='Some children'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLOR_2, label='No children'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9, fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
biosim.modelName = "sim_Work"
out = biosim.simulate(beta_values)

subset = subset.reset_index(drop=True)
subset["P0"] = out["P_JWC_0"].values
subset["P1"] = out["P_JWC_1"].values
subset["P2"] = out["P_JWC_2"].values
subset = subset.sort_values("TourTimeMinutes").reset_index(drop=True)

window = max(50, int(0.01 * len(subset)))
subset["P0_roll"] = subset["P0"].rolling(window, center=True).mean()
subset["P1_roll"] = subset["P1"].rolling(window, center=True).mean()
subset["P2_roll"] = subset["P2"].rolling(window, center=True).mean()

x    = subset["TourTimeMinutes"]
cum0 = subset["P0_roll"]
cum1 = subset["P0_roll"] + subset["P1_roll"]
cum2 = subset["P0_roll"] + subset["P1_roll"] + subset["P2_roll"]

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.fill_between(x, 0, cum0, color='cyan', label='JWC 0 — All-Children-Included')
plt.fill_between(x, cum0, cum1, color='green', label='JWC 1 — Partly-Children-Included')
plt.fill_between(x, cum1, cum2, color='yellow', label='JWC 2 — Children-Excluded')
plt.plot(x, cum0, color='black', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(x, cum1, color='black', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(x, cum2, color='black', linewidth=1)
plt.xlim(left=0)
plt.ylim(0, 1.0)
plt.xlabel("Tour Duration")
plt.ylabel("Probability")
plt.title("Tour Type Probability — Work")
plt.legend(loc='upper right')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
